paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar son of Yose, in Avin’s name, Ma'aserot 2:1;1:2 [Heilprin cites 1:3], in Tanchum bar Chiyya’s name. Tanchum of Kefar Gon in his name. If Yose ben Chalafta’s son, how could he report Tanchum bar Chiyya, in Chinena bar Pappa’s time, and Avun? Perhaps Elazar son of Yose bar Avin; see there.
